system_prompt_style.note: Skill prompt (SKILL.md) and workflow prompt builders not included in evidence; README says reviewers are instantiated 'from the project gatekeeper core + a generated domain overlay', suggesting composition, but the rendering code was not available.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: split manuscript (LaTeX or Markdown) into reading units, the canonical section list, and stable `passage-id`s
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: the harness decomposes the manuscript and feeds the whole paper to reviewers ('each read the WHOLE paper once'). The domain is manuscript review, not repository navigation.

context_compaction.note: Context handling is delegated to the host Claude Code. Isolation ('fresh eyes per round') bounds context by design, but no compaction code was available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: parallelism plus schema-validated output by construction
observation_format.note: Script CLIs support a --json mode; workflows return schema-validated output. Read-on-PDF is also mentioned.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: spawn the **same** N reviewers / jurors as **parallel `Agent`/`Task` subagents in a single message**
tool_call_format.note: Runs as a Claude Code skill and uses host tools (Bash, Workflow, Agent/Task). The harness adds no parser of its own.

tool_count.note: No tool schema array is shipped; the skill uses the host's tools and drives scripts via Bash.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: atomic apply + journal of a drafted patch; exact-once guard on `before` text
edit_primitive.note: Patches consist of before/after text pairs applied through apply-patch.js.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: parallelism plus schema-validated output by construction
tool_schema_source.note: Workflow output schemas are authored inside workflows/*.js; the source of the schema was not shown.

protocol_standardization.note: No source code or dependency grep was available; only the README and docs.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The courtroom engine is `assign-reviewers → reading-check → coverage-auditor → merge → {trial ‖ polish} → recall-audit → drafter → {edit-audit | meaning-audit} → clerk`.
loop_primitives.note: The default review mode is a fixed pipeline over one round. The jury with majority vote maps to multi_attempt. Auto mode loops review-revise rounds until the ledger gate passes.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: JSON ledger plus MD view; **gate = `/goal` completion fact**
planning_granularity.note: The ledger is an issue-tracking state object re-read across rounds, and the spine.json anchors are also stored. This is closer to a task list than a plan.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: N domain reviewers read the whole paper, a contestability router sends the real disputes to a two-sided trial, a jury of 5
multi_agent_topology.note: The orchestrator fans out to reviewers and jurors in the review mode. Direct-edit mode is single-agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: spawn the **same** N reviewers / jurors as **parallel `Agent`/`Task` subagents in a single message**
delegation_mechanism.note: Workflows are the preferred path; the Agent/Task subagent route is the fallback.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: **Never edit the manuscript without explicit author sign-off.**
human_in_loop.note: By default each edit requires sign-off. Auto mode switches to up-front spine/reviewer-assignment approval, the on_plan route.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The live, mutable issue state across rounds and sessions.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: the active project's memory: stable conventions worth recalling next session (this paper's house style, venue, persona tuning).
long_term_memory.note: Relies on Claude Code project memory; the ledger also persists across sessions.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
if a `.paper-review/` working copy AND a ledger exist, REUSE them, never
re-extract
state_persistence.note: Ledger state is reused across sessions.

self_verification.evidence_quote: `edit-audit` checks a risky non-anchor edit (make-sense + cross-section alignment); `meaning-audit` is the four-state frozen-anchor + arc audit.
self_verification.note: compile-guard runs a real LaTeX compile or a structural lint. Direct-edit mode self-checks via logic-check.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: `review` stops at the human gates and does not auto-advance.
retry_policy.note: Default review mode runs one round. Auto mode under /goal gives until_pass: it loops until the ledger gate passes, with hard-limit and quiescence backstops.

rollback.note: journal.js and apply-patch.js revert edits; on drift the edit is reverted and queued.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
Termination:
clerk convergence (primary) OR applied-quiescence (K dry rounds) OR a hard limit.
termination_condition.note: Auto mode ends on the gate pass, which is a verifiable condition (mapped to test_pass). The ultracode toggle sets maxRounds. Mapping clerk convergence to model_declared is approximate.

cost_controls.note: No cost configuration appears in the evidence. A fast mode is listed as TODO.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: all deterministic guards run orchestrator-side via Bash between workflow calls.
execution_isolation.note: Scripts run inside the host Claude Code session. The Workflow sandbox has no fs and no subprocess.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Your project files, ledger, journal, and patches stay inside your local paper project.
filesystem_access.note: Actual access is determined by host Claude Code permissions. The original .docx is never modified.

network_policy.note: No sandbox configuration surface in the evidence. The only network use described is the update check against GitHub.

permission_model.evidence_quote: it drafts the change, self-checks it, shows you the patch, and applies it after you approve.
permission_model.note: Auto mode uses a pre-authorized bounded-aggressive policy plus edit-safety rules, which amounts to a policy_engine.

tracing.note: The JSON ledger is also kept.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: **Validation of the engine on real papers at scale.**
eval_hooks.note: Listed on the roadmap as not shipped. Only a dogfood sample is included.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Safe fixes land under risk-proportional safety (frozen anchors, a per-passage edit cap, an anchor and cross-section meaning audit), always behind your sign-off.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A pre-submission AI review stress-test for research papers.

open_source.note: LICENSE file is present but its text was not shown; licence taken from the README badge.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: It is a Claude Code skill, installable two ways.

first_release_date.note: Based on the first stable v1 release; earlier 0.x versions existed.

stars.note: Star count not present in the evidence.
